snippet.title: Demons' Night Fever - Gameplay Trailer | Arc Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Kill friends and foes alike! The more you die, the stronger you get in this ruthless Speedrun-Training Simulation RPG. While built on classic grid-based tactical combat, Demons' Night Fever shatters conventions with its dark comedy "Servant Overwork Mechanic," forcing you to mercilessly sacrifice your own allies to win. The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle! Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!"

Arc System Works has dropped an all-new gameplay introduction trailer today. Demons' Night Fever is scheduled to launch later in 2026. Stay tuned for more updates!

Official Website:
https://www.arcsystemworks.jp/demonsnightfever/en/
